tie_metric: publisher ann-benchmarks knn absolute threshold GT_distance_k10+0.001; recompute returned-ID cosine on CPU; also strict ID recall as supplementary
warmup: one complete resident-search and host-wall sequence for each point per fresh process
service_timer: GPU-resident queries, synchronization-completed host search boundary, includes wrapper/planner; not pure kernel or CUDA events
wall_timer: preallocated pinned CPU query batch ready -> H2D -> search -> D2H both IDs/distances -> result ready; one batch completion sync
allocator: same RMM pool initial512MiB maximum10GiB, CuPy and C++ RMM, context margin2GiB; exact API qualification under lock
stream: one explicit nonblocking CuPy stream + cuVS Resources(stream.ptr), device sync at measurement boundaries
normalization: raw bytes preserved; CPU FP32 unit-norm normalization, cosine semantics unchanged
calibration_timing_method: three complete resident/host sequences per eligible h and batch;1792 different calibration-only queries, no duplicated/padded timing vectors; minimum geometric mean of two perquery median host walls, tie h9
